Your ambition sets the bar. Your effort decides how far you go.

Because ambition without effort is just a wish..

author: polariscampus
text:
What if places could talk? 🎧

That’s the idea behind Loci, built by Polaris students Sakshi Kasat and Manav Nayak.

Inspired by a boat ride in the Netherlands, they set out to make exploring the world more immersive - letting places tell their stories without you having to look them up.

But there was a catch: how do you know exactly where someone is, especially indoors? From exploring Wi-Fi fingerprinting to motion sensors and spatial mapping, the team had to tackle a real engineering challenge.

And the best part? When technology isn’t sure, Loci is designed not to guess.

One memory. One idea. Two student builders.

A 19-year-old student is building an AI companion for women’s health! 

Meet Raj, a second-year student at Polaris School of Technology, Bengaluru, who built MOMPULSE, an AI-powered app designed to support women through periods, pregnancy and motherhood.

From tracking periods and answering pregnancy-related questions to offering baby care guidance, MomPulse aims to provide personalised support at every stage of a woman’s journey.

Raj is building MomPulse while pursuing his studies, showing how young students are turning real-world problems into technology-driven solutions.
